Overview

Racine is a city in WI with a population of 77,000. Lake Michigan city with the Racine Art Museum and Danish heritage. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees.
